name: TickerK8 PRE ALPHA 0.0.5.0
body:
New Update Overview

This update introduces significant improvements in performance, structure, and usability.

Changes and Improvements:

The previous file-based structure (__00__main.py, __01__setobjectname, etc.) has been replaced with a clearer and more maintainable architecture: AStructure, AUi, and ALogic.
Objects are now created only when needed instead of all at once, resulting in improved performance.
Adapted the application to work with an online database (AWS RDS)
Added a new authentication system (login and registration)
Implemented a new data display system
